messages:
alex_w: quick heads-up — the INT8/GPTQ bakeoff for the new guava-13b variant is failing on TRT-LLM nodes with CUDA 12 drivers. error shows a kernel symbol mismatch when loading fused matmul kernels.
li-ml: ugh. is this the Hopper pool only or also Ampere?
maria.r: saw the same on a Hopper A10X but not on an Ampere A100 test box. could be cuBLASLt ABI differences across driver stacks.
alex_w: confirmed: Ampere (cuda 11.8 + trt-8.6) passes the quantized run. Hopper (cuda 12.1 + trt-8.7) hits: "failed to resolve symbol cublasLtMatmulAlgoGet" during TRT-LLM init.
tim_k: can you paste the exact error and the CLI you used to build the TRT engine? might be a build-time flag.
alex_w: pasted below — command used to build runtime image:
```
docker build --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12.1 --build-arg TRT=8.7 -t trtllm:guava-int8 .
python tools/compile_engine.py --model guava-13b --quant gptq --batch 8
```
error snippet: `trt_internal: symbol lookup error: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvinfer.so: undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmulAlgoGet`
li-ml: that symbol was introduced/renamed around cuBLASLt changes in 12.x. TRT 8.7 might be built against a different cuBLASLt header set. we saw ABI drift between cuda 11.8 and 12.1.
ml-ci-bot: [ci] triggered regression check for guava-13b int8 bakeoff (job: bakeoff-guava-13b-trt).
benchbot: baseline throughput (Ampere A100, INT8 GPTQ) = 115 toks/s, top-1 delta vs fp16 = -0.6%.
maria.r: Hopper numbers we've seen (when it doesn't crash) are slightly higher throughput but the ABI crash prevents us from measuring.
tim_k: short term: do a rebuild of TRT-LLM container with CUDA 11.8 toolchain and Triton 8.6, or build TRT-LLM from source against the system cuBLASLt headers on the Hopper nodes.
li-ml: also try using the vllm driver path (non-TRT) as a fallback for canary traffic — that avoids the fused kernels but is slower. we should add an automated fallback rule in the routing config.
alex_w: adding fallback route in the canary config now: `policy: prefer_trt; fallback: vllm-driver` — will monitor error rate.
ml-ci-bot: [ci] scheduled job `rebuild-trt-llm-hopper` (agent: eng-infra).
benchbot: added a column to the bakeoff sheet: `driver_tag`, `cuda`, `trt`, `notes`. link: https://go.internal/bakeoffs/guava-13b-int8 (internal).
maria.r: follow-up experiment idea: test AWQ quant path on Hopper with CUDA12 but using the Triton fallback plugin that disables fused cublasLt calls (`TRT_DISABLE_FUSED=1`). might avoid symbol usage.
li-ml: good call. if that works, perf delta will tell us how much fused kernels buy us on Hopper.
tim_k: long term: coordinate with infra to pin driver/dep matrix for TRT-LLM images and publish a compatibility matrix in the README. this is causing too many env-specific bugs.
alex_w: +1. i'll log an infra ticket and attach the crash logs and the minimal repro.
li-ml: assigning to infra: tag @eng-infra. thanks all — will update here with results from the TRTF_DISABLE run and the alternate build. :thumbsup:
